newsitem.title: USA: Clinton tax plan only has $70 bln net cut - Archer.
newsitem.headline: Clinton tax plan only has $70 bln net cut - Archer.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer said Wednesday that President Clinton's new tax plan only has $70 billion in net tax cuts over five years, falling short of the $85 billion goal.

The Texas Republican said an analysis by the congressional Joint Committee on Taxation showed Clinton's plan would provide $70.6 billion in tax relief over five years. The shortfall resulted from revenue raised from a proposed tobacco tax not included in tables released Monday, Archer said.
The Senate tax cut also falls short of the budget agreement goal and amounts to $77 billion over five years.
